description.narrative: The project’s primary goal is to support grassroots community organisations (CBOs) and self-help groups (SHGs) within communities affected by the violence in the Port-au-Prince Metropolitan area, the chronic migration issues at the DR/HT border, the climate vulnerability and the livelihood insecurity. The project objective is to utilize the SCLR approach to adopt more sustainable practices and mitigate the impacts of anthropogenic activities on their environment and livelihoods in Cornillon and Belladères, respectively West and Central departments of Haiti. This initiative aims to address immediate needs and enhance community preparedness and resilience against future disasters. The project aims to directly assist at least 100 vulnerable families, comprising approximately 500 individuals, by providing direct funding to CBOs/Self-Help Groups for the implementation of their priority initiatives within their respective communities. These families will be identified among the IDPs and vulnerable communities dependent on cross-border trade and employment opportunities. Identified vulnerable and marginalized groups include people living with disabilities, single mothers, older individuals lacking family support, and families living below the poverty line. The F&R will be from 24 June 2024 to 31 December 2024 for a total budget of USD 26,342.89.
